THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
REFERENCE ARCHIVE
068
Behind the image
15 / Amber Blouse
REFERENCE 5088.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 015
Art direction: 1970s-inspired bohemian portrait, warm rust and chestnut tones, natural skin
texture, dreamy and introspective.
Photorealistic vertical editorial portrait of an original adult woman with very long, loose
chestnut-brown waves parted in the center, light blue eyes, soft freckles and natural skin texture.
She sits leaning slightly forward with her hands resting near her knees, gazing up and away from
the camera with a quiet, thoughtful expression. She wears a sheer rust-orange floral-print blouse
with a pointed collar and ruffled cuffs, two delicate silver chain necklaces with a small round
pendant, and dark brown corduroy trousers. Soft overcast daylight, muted gray-green blurred
concrete wall background, warm rust and brown palette, 1970s bohemian mood, shallow depth of
field, subtle film grain, no text or logos.
16 / Tweed Corner
REFERENCE 5212.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 016
Art direction: Modern heritage fashion, black-and-ivory palette, defiant posture, minimal pale
studio walls.
Photorealistic vertical fashion editorial of an original adult East Asian woman with long, straight
black hair with a center part, leaning her shoulder against the corner of a pale gray-white room
with her arms crossed and a cool, confident gaze toward the camera. She wears an oversized ivory
bouclé tweed cardigan with black braided trim and a white collar, a black-and-white flecked tweed
ruffled mini skirt, black over-the-knee socks, and a black quilted leather chain-strap crossbody bag
with no logo. Soft diffused window light, minimalist pale gray walls, subtle shadows, high-end
contemporary fashion campaign, crisp tweed texture, muted monochrome palette, no text or
logos.
